store.summary: TNT MCP Link: let your AI app run commands and AV net tools on this device
store.description: Part of TNT (Tech Nomad Ted) tools, TheTechNomad.com. Turns the CardputerZero into an MCP server that AI apps (Claude, ChatGPT developer mode, OpenAI Codex and other MCP clients) can use from anywhere the device has internet: run commands and long background jobs, read, write and edit files, install and run programs (with an Admin / sudo switch), take screenshots of the built-in screen, and run TNT AV Net Tools checks on the network it is plugged into (find AV gear, Dante, PTP, multicast, LLDP, DHCP and more). It connects out through a free ngrok tunnel (QR codes on the screen walk you through it), a Cloudflare tunnel, or a no-account quick test tunnel, so no ports are opened on the network. Each app signs in with OAuth plus a one-time pairing code shown on this screen. Turn remote access on or off, watch live activity, disconnect everyone and set permissions from the keyboard. While it is on, other TNT apps show a dot in their title bar. Formerly TNT Remote.
